usage.callShape: POST https://gateway.spraay.app/api/v1/chat/completions with JSON body {model, messages, max_tokens?, temperature?}
usage.outputShape: body.choices[0].message.content (assistant text); body.usage for token/cost accounting; body.model echoes resolved model
usage.guide: OpenAI-compatible chat completions router (powered by OpenRouter, 200+ models). POST a standard chat body with required `model` and `messages` fields to https://gateway.spraay.app/api/v1/chat/completions; pay $0.04 USDC per call via x402 on Base (also accepts Solana). The response is the standard OpenAI completion object returned synchronously — read the assistant reply at body.choices[0].message.content and token usage at body.usage. Use any model ID supported by OpenRouter (e.g. gpt-4o-mini, openai/gpt-4o-mini).
